acceptance_measurements.title: One lot of machined shafts
acceptance_measurements.description: Synthetic teaching data: twenty-four diameter measurements from a single illustrative inspection lot.
notes: Invented deterministic teaching measurements; not actual inspection data.
Each row represents a different randomly sampled item from one lot.
For the guide example use k = 1.309, LSL = 9.95 mm, historical SD = 0.04 mm, and no USL.
The teaching comparison changes LSL to 9.98 mm. Real inspection limits and rules must be fixed before inspecting the sample.

acceptance_lot_sequence.title: A sequence of twelve inspected lots
acceptance_lot_sequence.description: Synthetic teaching data: twelve ordered component lots, each with 100 inspected items and a total lot size of 1,000.
notes: Invented deterministic teaching counts; not actual lot inspection records.
Nonconforming counts sampled items that fail at least one agreed criterion, counting each item once.
Assign all four columns and use Model Type = Without predictor.
Requires the Acceptance Sampling beta with Bayesian State-Space Sampling.
The final counts were chosen to illustrate changing quality. No model result or decision has been calculated by this guide.

acceptance_measurements_cm_preview.title: Shaft diameter in centimetres — preview
acceptance_measurements_cm_preview.description: Synthetic teaching data: all 24 original shaft measurements with an equivalent centimetre column.
notes: All 24 original measurements are preserved with Diameter_cm = Diameter_mm / 10. Use Measurement = Diameter_cm, LSL .995 cm, historical SD .004 cm, k=1.309 and USL off. Equivalent units avoid the inactive-upper-limit validation problem. Mean 1.002020833 cm; standardized lower distance 1.755208333 gives Accept under this illustrative prespecified rule. The raincloud displays the same 24 values.
